items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Petrillo, he wants more money for the musicians, which I thought that was right.

ctx.x: I noticed you weren't recording then. Is there a reason why you weren't recording?

Well, there was a strike of recording, some kind of problem with the Union. Petrillo, he wants more money for the musicians, which I thought that was right. The company that was making lot of money, paying nothing, no royalty for the musicians, so he considered that we should make more money. Those days, I think, we were making thirty dollars for a session of four numbers.
